transcript: Client: We have enterprise customers unable to access premium reporting after upgrading. We need a protected premium-access endpoint in the business service today. It must reject unauthenticated requests and allow valid premium subscribers. Product Manager: Understood. I am treating this as a P0. Requirements: add a protected GET /premium endpoint, return 401 without valid credentials, return 200 for a valid premium subscription, add tests, and prepare a draft PR for engineering review. Client: Correct. Please make sure the implementation is ready for review today. Engineer: @Relay take over this request, extract the specs, run tests, and open the PR.
